watches.name: Ordo Ab Chao Freehand Guilloche in 925 Silver
watches.description: Ordo Ab Chao — Limited Edition of 3 Born from the idea of finding order within apparent chaos, Ordo Ab Chao begins with a solid 925 silver dial and ends with a surface that changes continuously with the light. The guilloché is executed entirely by hand, leaving the individual tool marks visible rather than polishing them away. What initially appears almost random gradually reveals itself as a structured field of intersecting lines, reflections and shadows as the dial moves. There is no printed texture, no painted pattern and no applied decoration concealing the underlying work. The surface itself is the decoration. The dial is framed by a hand-finished chapter ring with individually carved hour markers and beaded minute markers, deliberately kept restrained so that the guilloché remains the focus. Powered by the LJP G101 automatic movement, Ordo Ab Chao is limited to just three individually numbered pieces. Technical description Case: stainless steel 316 Diameter: 40mm Thickness: 10.80mm Lug to Lug: 47,5mm Water resistance: 5 ATM Dial: 925 silver, bright-cut engraving, 18k plated brass chapter ring Hand finished mirror-polished steel case Regulated to +-5 secs/day in 4 positions and delivered with 3 years of warranty on the movement and 30 years on the artwork Swiss made movement : Manufacture La Joux-Perret G101. 68hrs power reserve Strap: Alligator leather strap
